application_id.description: The application id component of the Crunchy Bridge API key.

application_secret.description: The application secret component of the Crunchy Bridge API key.

bridgeapi_url.description: The API URL for the Crunchy Bridge platform API. Most users should not need to change this value.

require_token_swap.description: When true, forces an exchange of the API key for a short-lived bearer token.

cpu.description: The number of CPU units on the cluster's instance

id.description: The unique ID of the cluster in [EID format](https://docs.crunchybridge.com/api-concepts/eid)

is_ha.description: Whether the cluster is high availability, meaning that it has a secondary it can fail over to quickly in case the primary becomes unavailable. Defaults to `false`

maintenance_window_start.description: The hour of day which a maintenance window can possibly start. This should be an integer from `0` to `23` representing the hour of day which maintenance is allowed to start, with `0` representing midnight UTC. Maintenance windows are typically three hours long starting from this hour. A `null` value means that no explicit maintenance window has been set and that maintenance is allowed to occur at any time.

major_version.description: The cluster's major Postgres version. For example, `14`. Defaults to [Create Cluster](https://docs.crunchybridge.com/api/cluster/#create-cluster) defaults.

memory.description: The total amount of memory available on the cluster's instance in GB (gigabytes).

name.description: A human-readable name for the cluster.

plan_id.description: The ID of the [cluster's plan](https://docs.crunchybridge.com/concepts/plans-pricing/). Determines instance, CPU, and memory. Defaults to `hobby-2`.

provider_id.description: The [cloud provider](https://docs.crunchybridge.com/api/provider) where the cluster is located. Defaults to `aws`, allows `aws`, `gcp`, or `azure`

region_id.description: The [provider region](https://docs.crunchybridge.com/api/provider#region) where the cluster is located. Defaults to `us-west-1`

storage.description: The amount of storage available to the cluster in GB (gigabytes). Defaults to 100.

team_id.description: The ID of the parent [team](https://docs.crunchybridge.com/concepts/teams/) for the cluster.

updated_at.description: Time at which the cluster was last updated formatted as [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339).

wait_until_ready.description: Treats the create operation as incomplete until the cluster reports a ready status. Defaults to `false`

block.description: Cluster resource for the Crunchy Bridge Terraform Provider

default_team.description: The ID of the account's default team in [EID Format](https://docs.crunchybridge.com/api-concepts/eid)

personal_team.description: The ID of the account's personal team in [EID Format](https://docs.crunchybridge.com/api-concepts/eid)

team_membership.description: A listing of the account's team membership and role associated with those teams.

block.description: Data Source for retreiving Account team resource data

plans.description: Listing of available plans for this provider.

regions.description: Listing of valid regions for this provider.
